title: Commercial Finance Analyst

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company; F26 shows Excel reporting.
reasons.needs: Established company with formal training for graduates.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 40,000-50,000 per month for a Bangkok graduate programme. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Good commercial fit with a clear growth path.
jd_text: Agoda is hiring for Commercial Finance Analyst in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
